results.label: Board / list, page 1, sorted by fractional rank (the benchmark)
results.text:
select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.type, t.rank,
                  t.assignee_id, t.ticket_number, t.points, t.due_date, t.created_at
           from tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2
           order by t.rank asc, t.created_at desc, t.id asc
           limit 50 offset 0
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_rank

results.label: Same list at offset 3000 (offset pagination cost)
results.text:
select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.rank, t.created_at
           from tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2
           order by t.rank asc, t.created_at desc, t.id asc
           limit 50 offset 3000
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_rank

results.label: The COUNT(*) fired alongside every list request
results.text: select count(*) from tickets t where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2
nodes: Index Only Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_status

results.label: Search: leading-wildcard ILIKE on title
results.text:
select t.id, t.title from tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2 and t.title ILIKE '%ticket 1234%'
           order by t.rank asc limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_status

results.label: Board page 1 hydrated with assignees + labels (the relational `with` shape)
results.text:
select t.id, t.title, t.status, t.rank,
                  (select json_agg(json_build_object('id', u.id, 'name', u.name))
                     from ticket_assignees ta join users u on u.id = ta.user_id
                    where ta.ticket_id = t.id) assignees,
                  (select json_agg(json_build_object('id', l.id, 'name', l.name, 'color', l.color))
                     from ticket_label_mappings tlm join ticket_labels l on l.id = tlm.label_id
                    where tlm.ticket_id = t.id) labels
           from tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2
           order by t.rank asc, t.created_at desc, t.id asc
           limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_rank
Index Scan on ticket_assignees using uniq_ticket_assignees_ticket_user
Index Scan on ticket_label_mappings using uniq_ticket_label_mappings_ticket_label
Index Scan on ticket_labels using uniq_ticket_labels_org_id

results.label: My Work: assigned tickets across the whole org
results.text:
select t.id, t.title, t.status, t.priority, t.due_date, t.project_id
           from tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.assignee_id = $3 and t.status <> 'DONE'
           order by t.due_date asc nulls last limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_assignee_due_open

results.label: Per-column badge counts for the board
results.text:
select t.status, count(*) from tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2 group by t.status
nodes: Index Only Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_status

results.label: Ticket detail: comment thread
results.text:
select c.id, c.content, c.user_id, c.created_at
           from ticket_comments c
           where c.org_id = $1 and c.ticket_id = $4
           order by c.created_at desc limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on ticket_comments using idx_ticket_comments_ticket

results.label: Ticket detail: activity feed
results.text:
select a.id, a.action, a.from_value, a.to_value, a.created_at
           from ticket_activity_log a
           where a.org_id = $1 and a.ticket_id = $4
           order by a.created_at desc limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on ticket_activity_log using idx_ticket_activity_log_org_ticket

results.label: Dependency edges for a ticket (blocks / blocked_by)
results.text:
select r.id, r.relation_type, r.work_item_id, r.related_work_item_id
           from work_item_relations r
           where r.org_id = $1 and (r.work_item_id = $4 or r.related_work_item_id = $4)

results.label: Portfolio dashboard: per-project open/done rollup across the org
results.text:
select p.id, p.name,
                  count(*) filter (where t.status <> 'DONE') open_count,
                  count(*) filter (where t.status = 'DONE') done_count
           from projects p left join tickets t on t.project_id = p.id and t.org_id = p.org_id
           where p.org_id = $1
           group by p.id, p.name order by open_count desc limit 50
nodes: Index Only Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_status

results.label: Billing: approved billable hours + amount by project
results.text:
select ts.project_id, sum(ts.hours) hours, sum(ts.hours * coalesce(ts.bill_rate,0)) amount
           from timesheets ts
           where ts.org_id = $1 and ts.status = 'APPROVED' and ts.is_billable = true
           group by ts.project_id order by amount desc limit 50
